metadata.name: Workflow Presentation Generator
metadata.description: Creates a source-faithful, self-contained local HTML presentation for any authorized Moira workflow, with distinct business and technical views. It accepts an accessible Moira identity or authorized JSON path, materializes an execution-correlated workspace, obtains the complete source, validates it and generates the official full structural projection, labels source facts versus inference, scales large graphs through progressive disclosure, excludes secrets and unrelated private content, and produces network-independent HTML suitable for the Moira static sandbox. Deterministic file/HTML checks and genuinely independent semantic/visual review precede complete or reviewed-limited local delivery. Cause-owned source, content, HTML, completion and validation repair reruns stale gates; invalid criteria use independently reviewed contract correction. Autonomous mode skips only final acceptance. The workflow never mutates the source, publishes, uploads, notifies, commits, releases or deploys.

operating_mode.description: Whether final user acceptance is enabled.

presentation_principles.description: Outcome-oriented presentation criteria materialized for all roles.
presentation_principles.default:
# Presentation principles

Use only facts present in the authorized workflow, its official structural projection or supplied context; label supported inference and unknown business context. Explain user value without inventing users, metrics or guarantees. Preserve all important starts, teleports, branches, cycles, terminals, failure routes and data flow. Keep the main narrative understandable and move complete large-graph topology into progressive disclosure or an appendix. Exclude credentials, tokens and unrelated private literals. Produce one accessible, responsive, print-friendly HTML file with embedded resources and no network dependency. Mechanical checks prove only storage and syntax properties; business accuracy, technical faithfulness, hierarchy and visual usefulness require direct independent judgment.

workflow_source.description: Exact Moira identity or authorized JSON path.

presentation_scope.description: Focus, constraints, sensitivity and output requirements.

result_status.description: Producer-completion class reviewed with the exact presentation.

revision_request.description: Active contract correction or user rework request.

reentry_owner.description: Earliest stale normal owner after contract correction.

terminal_status.description: Truthful terminal class for the presentation execution.

nodes.directive: Resolve the exact authorized workflow source, primary audience and use, output language, focus/sensitivity constraints and operating mode from the request and discoverable context. Use retained examples such as moira/verified-research, never removed moira/research. Ask only for a material unknown. Return ready or blocked; do not fetch, read or mutate the source yet.
nodes.completionCondition: The source, presentation contract and local-only authority are actionable or blocked

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write immutable presentation-contract.md from source {{workflow_source}}, type {{source_type}}, audience {{target_audience}}, use {{presentation_use}}, language {{output_language}}, scope {{presentation_scope}} and local-only authority. Initialize repair-account.md with a factual header. Return ready or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The immutable contract exists or its blocker is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the effective contract and revision_request {{revision_request}}. For source_type=id, obtain one complete authorized definition through a download token; do not use a bounded node page. For source_type=file, read the exact authorized path. Preserve complete candidates, record identity/provenance and select one without mechanical merge. Write workflow.json and source-provenance.md, validate the exact source with official moira-workflow, generate and inspect the exact complete workflow-schema.txt, and confirm semantic meaning in JSON. Never mutate the source or copy it into context. When a current presentation-validation.md or presentation-review.md assigns a finding to this owner, reproduce the complete owner-local class, append one factual repair-account entry, then update the owned artifact. Return replan for an invalid/non-local criterion and blocked for an irreducible failure.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact complete source and official projection are current or the upstream/blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the effective contract, presentation-principles.md, complete workflow.json, source-provenance.md, workflow-schema.txt and revision_request {{revision_request}}. Write presentation-content.md and limitations.md. Ground business purpose and examples in source facts or label supported inference/unknowns. Explain all important starts, teleports, branches, cycles, terminals, failures and data flow. For large graphs keep an understandable main narrative plus complete searchable/collapsible topology or appendix. Exclude credentials, tokens and unrelated private literals. When a current presentation-validation.md or presentation-review.md assigns a finding to this owner, reproduce the complete owner-local class, append one factual repair-account entry, then update the owned artifact. Return replan for an invalid/non-local criterion and blocked for an irreducible failure.
nodes.completionCondition: Source-grounded business and complete scale-appropriate technical content are current or blocked/replanned

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the effective contract, presentation-principles.md, presentation-content.md, workflow-schema.txt, limitations.md and revision_request {{revision_request}}. Build presentation.html as one parseable self-contained file with embedded CSS/optional JS, semantic headings, keyboard-usable navigation, responsive and print styles, and progressive disclosure. Use native embedded HTML/CSS/SVG for diagrams. Do not use external scripts, fonts, styles, fetch/XHR/WebSocket, forms, CDNs or another runtime dependency. When a current presentation-validation.md or presentation-review.md assigns a finding to this owner, reproduce the complete owner-local class, append one factual repair-account entry, then update the owned artifact. Return replan for an invalid/non-local criterion and blocked for an irreducible failure.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact self-contained HTML is current or blocked/replanned

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Reread the effective contract, source/projection, content, exact HTML and limitations. When current validation/review assigns a completion finding, reproduce it and append repair-account.md. Close foreseeable omissions, atomically write completion.md and return matching result_status, presentation_summary and limitation_summary. Complete requires full contracted support; limited is allowed only for a useful result with explicit non-critical source-context or rendering limitations. Invalid or self-inconsistent HTML is blocked. When a current presentation-validation.md or presentation-review.md assigns a finding to this owner, reproduce the complete owner-local class, append one factual repair-account entry, then update the owned artifact. Return replan for an invalid/non-local criterion and blocked for an irreducible failure.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact result is producer-complete and truthfully classified or blocked/replanned

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the exact contract, source/projection identity, presentation.html, limitations.md and completion.md. Overwrite presentation-validation.md with deterministic observations only: required files, source/projection identity, parseable HTML, internal anchors, embedded resources and absence of network/runtime dependencies. When the previous report assigns validation as owner, repair only the observation method/report. Do not infer business accuracy, technical faithfulness, visual hierarchy or audience fit. Return pass, one earliest repair owner, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: One exact modality-correct deterministic report is current

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate one genuinely independent whole-result reviewer; if no independent mechanism exists, return blocked. The reviewer reads the exact contract, source JSON, provenance, complete projection, content, HTML, limitations, completion and validation. It judges business accuracy, supported inference, technical faithfulness, progressive disclosure, sensitive-data safety, hierarchy, accessibility and usefulness; render/screenshots in a network-disabled environment when supported and record an honest limitation otherwise. Overwrite presentation-review.md with all current blockers or zero findings. Diagnose, never repair. Return pass, one earliest repair owner, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: One independent exact-result review owns every current blocker by earliest cause

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Reassess active revision_request {{revision_request}} against immutable presentation-contract.md, repair-account.md and accepted corrected-contract.md. Never change originating source/sensitivity/local-only authority. Overwrite corrected-contract.md with one cumulative bounded correction and name earliest reentry_owner source|content|html|validation|completion. Return corrected or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: A bounded authority-preserving correction and earliest re-entry exist or are blocked

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate independent review of corrected-contract.md against immutable presentation-contract.md, repair-account.md and earlier accepted corrections. Overwrite corrected-contract-findings.md. Pass only when goal, source, sensitivity and local-only authority are preserved and reentry_owner is earliest; replan repeats reassessment with changed knowledge; blocked ends truthfully.
nodes.completionCondition: The cumulative correction independently passes or its replan/blocked cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted local HTML at {{presentation_path}}, summary {{presentation_summary}} and limitations {{limitation_summary}}. Ask to accept, abort or request one concrete source|content|html|validation|completion|contract rework with nonblank revision_request. Do not infer publication or copy authority.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepted, aborted or supplied one owner-scoped rework request

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read completion.md and write final-report.md for the exact accepted complete local presentation. Preserve presentation_path {{presentation_path}}, summary {{presentation_summary}} and limitations {{limitation_summary}}. Do not upload, publish, copy or notify.
nodes.completionCondition: The truthful local terminal report is current without reclassifying the accepted result

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read completion.md and write final-report.md for the exact accepted reviewed-limited local presentation, prominently preserving presentation_path {{presentation_path}} and limitations {{limitation_summary}}. Do not upload, publish, copy or notify.
nodes.completionCondition: The truthful local terminal report is current without reclassifying the accepted result

nodes.hint: Use only when the presentation process, interpretation or criterion itself is invalid, not for an ordinary source, validation or review finding.
nodes.directive: Return one nonblank revision_request that corrects the remaining presentation process while preserving originating source, sensitivity and local-only authority and naming still-valid work. Do not bypass an ordinary failed gate.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded process correction can enter independent corrected-contract review
